description: A short check for HR and recruitment staff at Tarrowby Logistics, a fictional company, taken after the awareness episodes (pair BA). Ten new emails from the Tarrowby recruitment inbox, the same kinds as before. It is matched to the first check (awareness_pre_hr_ba), and the end screen compares the two results when the first check was finished.
organiser_note: each role's check tests the channel that role meets in its episode, and in a session that runs more than one episode only the learner's primary-role check is recorded.
